lecture_07.title: CS336 Spring 2026, Lecture 7: Parallelism (Percy Liang)
lecture_07.note: Line anchors refer to the local clone; discovered.json records sha256 7cdec6c6... so anchors can be re-verified. This version of the lecture covers collectives, hardware, NCCL/torch.distributed, two NCCL benchmarks, and forward-only toy implementations of data, tensor and pipeline parallelism on a deep MLP. ZeRO/FSDP is explicitly deferred to the next lecture (L387); the pipeline-bubble formula and ZeRO stage accounting are student-line supplements anchored to papers below.

lecture_07_stdout.title: CS336 Lecture 7: recorded stdout of one Modal run (4 GPUs, CUDA 13.2)
lecture_07_stdout.note: Linked from lecture_07.py:L43. Used only as evidence for *relative* observations (which ranks differ, how the two benchmarks compare, that params agree after DDP). The millisecond durations and GB/s readouts are single-run, 4-GPU numbers on unspecified hardware and are deliberately not restated as facts in any KP.

zero_2019.title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models (Rajbhandari et al., 2019)
zero_2019.note: Not linked in lecture_07.py (it appears in official/lectures/references.py as zero_2019). The lecture names ZeRO/FSDP at L68, L183 and L387 ('Next time'). Section 5 / Figure 1 of the paper give the per-device memory 2Ψ+2Ψ+KΨ with K=12 (fp32 master params + two Adam moments) and the stage-wise formulas 4Ψ+12Ψ/N, 2Ψ+14Ψ/N, 16Ψ/N used by the zero-sharding KP.

gpipe_2018.title: GPipe: Efficient Training of Giant Neural Networks using Pipeline Parallelism (Huang et al., 2018)
gpipe_2018.note: Not linked in lecture_07.py (references.py: gpipe_2018). Section 2.2 gives the bubble overhead O((K−1)/(M+K−1)) for K partitions and M micro-batches, used by the pipeline-bubble KP; the lecture only says 'break up into micro batches to minimize the bubble' (L508).

megatron_lm_2019.title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism (Shoeybi et al., 2019)
megatron_lm_2019.note: Not linked in lecture_07.py (references.py: megatron_lm_2019). Section 3 pairs a column-split with a row-split so an MLP block needs one all-reduce in forward and one in backward; the lecture's toy TP instead all-gathers after every layer (L472). Cited in the tensor-parallelism filtering_note only.

megatron_parallelism_2021.title: Efficient Large-Scale Language Model Training on GPU Clusters Using Megatron-LM (Narayanan et al., 2021)
megatron_parallelism_2021.note: Not linked in lecture_07.py (references.py: megatron_parallelism_2021). Composition of tensor, pipeline and data parallelism ('3D'); the lecture names combinations only at L62. Used by the parallelism-axes KP for the per-device parameter accounting under composition.
